stories.headline: In a London synagogue, a Jewish David stands up to the Green Party’s Goliath - opinion
stories.summary: As Elie Wiesel said in his oft-repeated guidance: “Stand up, do not stay quiet. Neutrality helps the oppressor, never the victim. Silence encourages the tormentor, never the tormented.”

stories.headline: Abdul El-Sayed fields accusations of family ties to terror orgs. as midterms apporach - report
stories.summary: El-Sayed, a Michigan-born child of Egyptian immigrants, has recently come under scrutiny for his family's purported ties to the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt.

stories.headline: Captain of flydubai plane describes blocking axe blows as co-pilot attacked
stories.summary: "Immediately, my hand went to the knob that opens the door, and I screamed for my colleagues, screaming his name," Captain Smit Machchhar said on the attack.

stories.headline: Rabbis for Human Rights files police complaint over Rabbi Lior’s Palestinian olive harvest ruling
stories.summary: Rabbis for Human Rights said its acting director submitted the complaint on behalf of its 170 members, alleging incitement to racism, incitement to violence, and encouraging the theft of property.

stories.headline: At least four killed in major fire at Canadian military base
stories.summary: At least four people were killed and 39 seriously injured in a fire at an Alberta military base, as firefighters battled fierce winds overnight to contain the blaze.

stories.headline: Paris synagogue, several Jewish-affiliated sites vandalized on weekend, antisemitic motive unlikely
stories.summary: Amid reports of incidents targeting Jewish sites in France, the SPCJ urged the Jewish community to exercise caution, avoid spreading unverified claims of antisemitism, and rely on official updates.

stories.headline: West Bank attacks on Washington Post journalist, diplomats may signal dangerous trend - analysis
stories.summary: No matter who is prime minister after October 27, if the situation in the West Bank does not come under control, violent Jewish extremists could become an even greater direct danger to Israel.

stories.headline: Macron condemns 'shocking' scenes of violence across France, points to 'insurrectionist far-left'
stories.summary: "Looking at these images, we have all asked ourselves: what was going through their minds? How can French people do this to France?" Macron said in a televised address to the nation.

stories.headline: Vienna flight from Tel Aviv diverted to Bulgaria over bomb threat
stories.summary: The Israel Air Force has noted that the incident did not occur in or near Israeli airspace, and therefore they are not involved in the incident and were not required to act at this time.

stories.headline: Kenya confirms eighth Ebola case as regional outbreak spreads
stories.summary: Kenya has been on heightened alert, as a major Ebola outbreak centered in Congo has spread across borders in the region.

stories.headline: How much will Trump’s endorsement help Netanyahu? - analysis
stories.summary: Some pundits speaking on Israeli news outlets criticized Trump for “interfering” in Israel’s election, while others put it down to the fact that Trump does not want the US to fight Iran alone.

stories.headline: Israel urged Qatar to continue Gaza funding despite public criticism, documents reveal
stories.summary: According to an investigation by TIME magazine, successive Israeli governments helped establish, operate, and preserve the Qatari assistance mechanism for Hamas-controlled Gaza for years.

stories.headline: Rubio Says Trump To Take up to 60 Days To Weigh Russia Sanctions
stories.summary: "A lot of you don't know what my decision is yet, but we'll figure it out, and you'll figure it out," Trump told reporters at his Mar-a-Lago club.

stories.headline: 1 Killed, 5 Injured in Ukrainian Drone Attack on St. Petersburg, Governor Says
stories.summary: Russian air defense units downed 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry said.
